episodes.title: Same chassis, different oil
episodes.summary: Two-voice cut on the Engine. One side: synthesis — music as field guide, rarity and frequency of decay, slam window, standing leak. The other: ΔS as a negotiated chore wearing physics clothes, edge collusion, late burn as sociology. Reputation stays out of the XP mint. CT is a different meter. Oil in a rusted chassis vs a different scale.

episodes.title: How social consensus decays the universe

episodes.title: Homelessness is a signal loss crisis
episodes.summary: NotebookLM deep dive on And That. Homelessness is not a housing shortage — it is what happens when every feedback loop goes deaf. Cash on symptoms, dodge causation. You cannot patch a soul with a voucher and a mat. DAG of verified delta S, XP as access not a cash-out. You cannot house a person back into a name.

episodes.title: Escaping the recursive loop of human control
episodes.summary: Closing the Loop as systems audit. Determinism vs the glitch. Monkey middleware, MKUltra-to-algorithm, compression warfare, burn the arc, God as entropy reduced by love, homelessness as dead feedback. Are you writing the code or is it writing you?

episodes.title: The cold math of mild spanking
episodes.summary: NotebookLM on the Mild Spanking Efficiency paper. Person-as-DAG, severity lock, XP vs settlement time, confounders (severity, genetics, child-evoked), Sweden 1979. Exploration of the argument, not an endorsement.
